question: Who among the following was appointed as the first female chief of MI6 in June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Blaise Metreweli**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Blaise Metreweli** was officially named as the next Chief of the **Secret Intelligence Service (SIS)**, popularly known as **MI6**, in **June 2025**.
 
• With this appointment, she becomes the **first female** to lead the **United Kingdom's** foreign intelligence agency in its **116-year history** since it was founded in **1909**.
 
• She succeeded **Sir Richard Moore**, who had held the position of Chief—traditionally referred to by the code name **"C"**—since **October 2020**.
 
• Before being selected for this prestigious role, **Metreweli** served as a senior official within the **Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office (FCDO)**, bringing extensive experience in international relations and national security.
